sections.heading: A more flexible way to get senior marketing leadership.

items.q: At what ARR does a scale-up typically need a fractional CMO?
items.a: ARR alone is a poor trigger. The stronger signal is that GTM decisions have become strategically important, the existing team needs senior leadership, and a permanent CMO is either premature or unnecessarily rigid. A scale-up can reach that point at very different revenue levels depending on market, sales motion and team.

items.q: Fractional CMO or promoting our existing marketing lead?
items.a: Promote the internal lead when they are ready to own the strategic, commercial and organisational parts of the role, not simply because they know the company. A fractional CMO can also work alongside that person, giving them support and experience while the business tests what the senior role actually needs to become.

items.q: How long does a typical scale-up engagement last?
items.a: It depends on the constraint. A focused GTM problem can be addressed over a shorter engagement, while embedded leadership usually lasts longer because decisions, execution and measurement need to run through several cycles. We define the outcome and working rhythm first rather than selling a fixed-duration fractional CMO package.

sections.heading: Find the constraint before adding more marketing.
